correctness.rationale: The first-edge split produces exact moment recurrences. Formal differentiation and integration yield the explicit generating functions; exact coefficient identities agree with all 629 packaged rational checks, including exhaustive arrival orders through n=8. A uniform exponential-tail bound of at most 5574423318619/74071065600000<1/12 for every n≥10 establishes strict negativity beyond the finite table, and coefficient extraction settles n=2..9. The limit is −(e^(−1)+e^(−3))/4. Computation supports but does not replace the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The new mixed invariant measures the relationship between a local boundary vacancy and the global jammed matching size, which neither marginal expectation can reveal. Strict all-size negativity with exactly one nontrivial exceptional zero and a finite nonzero thermodynamic limit is a natural and substantive boundary-dependence classification. The generating function is exact and useful for further boundary-sensitive adsorption questions.
